title: The Alibi of Saint Alder's Again
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Ulyana Dravenmoor, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
